name: ecb_data_portal-mcp
display_name: ECB Data Portal (SDMX time series) MCP
description: ECB Data Portal (SDMX time series) (market data): get_series. Every tool maps to a documented endpoi

tools.name: get_series
tools.description: series_id is '<flowRef>/<key>' naming ONE series, e.g. EXR/D.USD.EUR.SP00.A (daily USD per EUR reference rate) or FM/M.U2.EUR.4F.KR.MRR_FR.LEV. start/end are ISO dates or SDMX periods (2024-01, 2024-Q1). Without start the whole history is returned. A key matching no series is a 404. The Accept header pins SDMX-ML generic data (XML): the API content-negotiates and would answer SDMX-JSON to application/json, and its format= parameter does not override Accept.
